items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Then they'd have a band from Donisonville came down one time, Clayborne Williams... For this particular night we had this contest with Clayborne Williams band. All of us, our band, well those that wanted to drink and those with Clayborne Williams band, got together and we drank there until about fiv

ctx.x: Uh-huh. And I remember the street that we lived on was the head of running, go to railroad street, which is about half a block. There was a store named Babin, B-A-U-B-I-N, we used to trade from. And, uh, I went to a public school going towards railroad street, going towards, from my house, to the railroad station. But, uh, my first school was through a, a colored lady named Miss, uh, Rita. Mm-hmm. So I was a little private, a primary school, you know, where you go and learn your APCs and everything. And from…
By the way, uh, did you ever know where Joe Oliver was from?
